name: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri
name_pt: O Espírito e o Gênio de S. Filipe Neri
author: Frederick William Faber
desc: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri (1850): three lectures delivered in the London Oratory in the triduum before the feast of St. Philip: St. Philip a portrait of Jesus, St. Philip the representative saint of modern times, and St. Philip in England.
desc_pt: O Espírito e o Gênio de S. Filipe Neri (1850): três conferências pronunciadas no Oratório de Londres no tríduo anterior à festa de S. Filipe: S. Filipe, retrato de Jesus; S. Filipe, o santo representativo dos tempos modernos; e S. Filipe na Inglaterra.
edition: The Spirit and Genius of St. Philip Neri (London: Henry Lucas, 1850), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
srcnote: The three lectures; the contents is dropped, and the unrelated work bound after them is left out.

units.title: Lecture I. St. Philip a Portrait of Jesus
